description_zh: 调用ReleaseCapacityReservation释放容量预定服务
kebab_example: aliyun ecs release-capacity-reservation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --private-pool-options-id crp-bp67acfmxazb40000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseCapacityReservation

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the capacity reservation. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 容量预定服务所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the capacity reservation
parameters.name: private_pool_options_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values: false. Currently, only false is supported, which indicates that the capacity reservation is directly released without a dry run
parameters.help_zh: 是否对此次请求进行检索。取值：false，目前仅支持不检索本次请求，直接释放容量预定服务
parameters.name: dry_run
